Geographic boundaries: Natural Earth 1:50m admin 0 countries (public domain)
https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
Downloaded 2026-10-29, compacted by scripts/prepare-geography.py.
Boundaries reflect Natural Earth's de facto view and are used for all years.
